The Department of Defense awarded CACI a $100 million contract to supply counter-UAS capabilities for southern-border defense [1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPUlJuRXBzNFVreXdlZUgzX1p5VUxDTm9wTUdQNmVodThWdy12dGdxNkhXRXM1SWJZWHRHWGxFN1h2ZGthYlJtNkJJRjllY0cyUU5lYWp5d3ZxTlFjemQ2VGtsTFJHazVKX3dTd3NFODhLY1FjTXNCRnY4MmpuelhmZ0JMQmxMVzBSYlRsX08tUzRBdW9YMVV1N24xUGlhT0w1Qk9DSjZORnVMNl8zOTVPMUlmN2hUUDVYcjc2cQ?oc=5). The Federal Bureau of Investigation issued a SAFER SKIES counter-drone operations framework to manage UAS threats [2](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFBzMFctbEV1ZFpIN1gzU09ySUc0Smk0WnQwcUYyVDFybFF1YkF0Z1VaSGtKdE92VGtQdDFCaTM1S0xGVEpubnZRRTY1aHdtUnJRcXp6Ynl5N2Joa3A2VFo0RTJGSXNhaG5EQjdnRGgxcTlzQlI5UDZkejB1Zw?oc=5). The Federal Aviation Administration proposed a noise-based standard to replace the overland supersonic flight ban, marking the first step toward authorizing supersonic operations over land [3](https://news.google.?oc=5).

Tesla began employee rides on the Cybercab at Gigafactory Texas, advancing its robotaxi program [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOX0pGcjdSR0s5Z1YzX3FXMXNjYTQ1N2dFMmczbUJ5eXEwcFVuQTFoRjlRTUFMX3QxQVUzd29ocFNZeHpGNUhBYUo5ZzJucWc3SEIzbi02RVR4RmIxRGpzOTdPUndDTHhOd2ZDUWQyTTNmWjdEbUlDWFNHRWpmMmJIcDh4QlZTV3prYmNZdWRIbFl2UExSNWZRQUJMM0tKeHBKSW02QTJxN2laY1VQ?oc=5). Washington, D.C. council members are debating robotaxi legislation, while San Francisco reports additional Waymo-related disruptions and possible fines for impeding emergency response [5](https://news.google.?oc=5). AT&T and Ericsson demonstrated drone-detection technology near AT&T Stadium in Arlington [6](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxORjVmd3hhYWFJd3B4bmwwY1FZQkRGVjdGMGxUc2VWdklHNnFjNUlJZV9lYkxkZjJUbDJZbzBDVGtXazhfTm5Qc00yaGoyRlVpb3RHVXJqcVp5Q2tFNEhJQXZIX3dScWtSUzVzaGRFQTN4VUtlSWRmWVhiR3BCN2ozVHVBU2dFalJqUklKU2tKYzlndXhuOE51Rmp6bFE1VndjTnNCZGNVSU5UZw?oc=5).

The FAA cleared a drone for avalanche-control operations in the United States [7](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNbk9tcmo2YWEzamtBZ1lvYlpBejd2M3JQWEFrdmNxNEVWX3l0SU42QnNRR3psSTFycWdvOEc3T2F4NnZXNFBZRkoySDFpaTdUUDVIYXV6amZxZVVMR2F1UndHZmZHRW9xNGJySE1DdEpzZEhDX3EtSHZ2N0ZXTVpXVDgwelpKUGVGM1RDMy1jM3hTUC10dTNJ?oc=5). Federal authorities launched a pilot program for electric aircraft in Virginia [8](https://news.google.?oc=5). Manna selected Tulsa as a base for a major U.S. drone-delivery expansion [9](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOSTlGVHNNM2NZcFNPdndHbkNZbVFiOUVabE4zX3I2NUJJVmxYT0hkWndMbTFRZFpsZGxhcFJpSkxIczJreGpfREVoMFJhaTRCRmdGNlEwTzJUMk5wWFpiaTRibjZTclN6RjZJWW5LRzBGM1BPVVg0SnZuOWdfUUt0Ylp1LVBBZw?oc=5). Eve Air Mobility reported progress in eVTOL flight testing and stated it has a clear path to certification [10](https://news.google.?oc=5).
